benefits.name: Anniversary free night
benefits.notes: Free Night Award each account anniversary, valid at properties up to 35,000 points (top-up allowed).

benefits.name: Airline credit
benefits.notes: $50 statement credit after $250+ spent directly with airlines in each period. New cardmembers (applied 6/4-12/31/2026): 6/4-12/31/2026 and 1/1-6/30/2027. Existing cardmembers (by 1/7/2026; one-time activation required): 1/1-6/30/2026 and 7/1-12/31/2026.

benefits.name: Instacart credit
benefits.notes: $10 credit loaded into your Instacart+ account each month; requires an active Instacart+ membership (3 months complimentary, then paid) and an order paid with the card. Unused credit expires at month end.

benefits.name: DoorDash promo
benefits.notes: $10 off one non-restaurant DoorDash order each calendar quarter while enrolled in DashPass via the card (12 months complimentary, then paid). Offer runs through 12/31/2027 (activate DashPass by then).

benefits.name: Silver Elite status
benefits.notes: Automatic Marriott Bonvoy Silver Elite status each calendar year as a cardmember (initial award within 8 weeks of account opening).

benefits.name: Elite Night Credits
benefits.notes: 15 Elite Night Credits within 60 days of account opening, then on or before March 1 of each subsequent calendar year (primary cardmember; card account open; linked Marriott Bonvoy account). Also 1 Elite Night Credit per $5,000 in purchases, with no limit.

benefits.name: Gold Elite status (spend)
benefits.notes: Path to Gold Elite status after $35,000 in purchases in a calendar year (Jan 1-Dec 31); allow up to 8 weeks after qualifying. Only one Boundless card per Marriott Bonvoy member.

benefits.name: DashPass membership
benefits.notes: 12 months of complimentary DashPass when first activated with the card by 12/31/2027, then auto-renews at the paid rate until cancelled. Activation window 2/1/2025-12/31/2027.
